zh.title: Windows 覆盖安装隔离修复
highlights: 修复 v3.37.3 覆盖安装时旧运行时目录清理失败、安装被阻断的问题。
旧运行时改为移入唯一隔离目录，不再以直接删除作为安装前提；隔离目录保留回滚材料。
只有改名失败才中止，日志记录真实源路径与目标路径；账号、配置和会话数据不参与隔离。

en.title: Windows reinstall quarantine fix
highlights: Fixed v3.37.3 reinstalls being blocked when the previous runtime directory could not be purged.
Previous runtimes are moved into unique quarantine directories instead of being deleted, preserving rollback data.
Only a failed rename aborts installation, with exact source and destination paths logged; accounts, settings, and sessions are not quarantined.
